evidence.readme: Defines the QAMPARI method as deterministic lossless additive compression
evidence.v2_protocol: Defines 12 source-preserving lossless binary packets and add-only deployment
evidence.runtime: The canonical QampariTargetRunner renders chat text and token IDs; it exposes no deployment inputs_embeds contract
evidence.method_change_required: Latent memory would replace recoverable source text with learned lossy vectors and require a white-box Target interface

alternative_scope: A separately named white-box lossy representation study could be opened only by explicitly changing the paper and deployment contract; it cannot be reported as continuation of the present lossless method
